QuestInfo.name: Giant Snowman's Purple box
QuestInfo.0: Bill is frantically looking for a Purple box. I wonder why...
QuestInfo.1: If I find the Purple box for Bill, she promised to open the box for me. I wonder what's inside that box...
QuestInfo.2: Bill was gracious enough to open the Purple box for me. It also felt good to contribute 50 mesos towards kids that are less fortunate in MapleStory.

0.0: Hey, that's the Purple box!! You must have defeated the Snowman! Do you want to give me the gift box? I'll remove the item from the box for you~ it'll only cost 50 mesos!

yes.0: Ok, I'll open it for you. Please talk to me again few seconds later.

no.0: Are you really sure that you don't want to open it? There might be something good in it..

1.0: You came back! Let me see, I'll open the box~

yes.0: Tada! Here's what's inside the box! Don't worry, those 50 mesos will be spent towards the kids in MapleStory that are less fortunate~

item.0: Hey, you didn't get me the white box, yet. Let me know when you do find the box.
